composition_strategy: Asymmetric-cluster composition with a focus on the upper right section to guide the viewer's eye diagonally through the scene.
focal_strategy: The focal point is located in the upper right area, drawing attention to a prominent feature or subject.
depth_strategy: A shallow depth plan to create a sense of flatness and emphasis on the foreground.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: Open perimeter to allow for a natural flow and unobstructed view of the scene.
title_safe_region_strategy: The title will be placed in a calm, quiet upper region to avoid competing with the focal point.
programme_safe_region_strategy: The programme will be positioned in the lower section to maintain a clean separation from the title and focal area.
